page_title: ClipSpeedAI: the AI Video & Image Studio for Creators

sources.entry: ClipSpeedAI - AI-powered video clipping that automatically finds and extracts the best highlight moments from long-form videos for streamers and content creators.

summary.name: ClipSpeedAI
summary.one_liner: ClipSpeedAI is a web-based AI studio for creators and brands that generates AI videos, images, AI influencers, character swaps and ads, and turns long videos into captioned short clips.
use_cases: Turn a podcast or long stream into captioned vertical shorts
Generate text-to-video clips for social media
Create product ad images and short video ads
Build a consistent AI influencer character for posts
Swap a character into a viral trend clip
Schedule and publish clips to TikTok, Reels, Shorts, X and LinkedIn
summary.what_it_does: The page describes two main areas: an AI clipping agent that takes a link or uploaded long video, picks highlight moments, scores them for viral potential, keeps the speaker in frame and adds word-by-word captions, with a calendar for scheduling posts. The second area is generative: text-to-video using models named as Seedance, Kling, MiniMax and Veo, AI image generation with Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 2, a character builder with 22 original looks and character sheets, and Morphaze, which swaps a chosen character into an existing video. It also offers an MCP server so Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf and similar apps can run ClipSpeed tasks from chat.
notable: MCP server at api.clipspeed.ai/mcp that works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code and Windsurf
Morphaze character swap that replaces the person in a viral clip while keeping timing and camera
Character builder producing a look sheet with close-up and full-body views
Start-frame workflow: generated images can become the first frame of an AI video
caveats: Paid plans start at $19/month (Starter) after a $1 3-day trial; a card is required and billing follows the trial
The Claude connector is listed as included on every paid plan; ChatGPT access depends on plan and is described as rolling out
Campaign rewards are described as varying by campaign, approval, eligible views and payout caps
